sample_queries.individuals_by_age_sex: SELECT individual_id, sex, date_of_birth FROM individual WHERE date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND sex IS NOT NULL;
sample_queries.pregnancies_with_outcomes: SELECT pregnancy_id, mother_id, outcome, delivery_date FROM pregnancy WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL;
sample_queries.vaccination_coverage: SELECT vaccine_type, COUNT(*) as total_doses FROM vaccination GROUP BY vaccine_type;
sample_queries.migration_flows: SELECT migration_type, COUNT(*) as total_migrations FROM migration_event GROUP BY migration_type;
sample_queries.education_enrollment_status: SELECT school_level, currently_enrolled, COUNT(*) as total FROM education GROUP BY school_level, currently_enrolled;
